$comment: Phase 4 step 5. Written 2026-08-18 from eval/noise_floor.json, never before a baseline existed.
Read src/musical_mycelium/eval/thresholds.py for the three-state PASS/FAIL/N-A design and
docs/phases/phase-4-eval-suite-IMPLEMENTATION.md 'Step 5, as-built' for why two of the five
gates are not percentages. Every bound below carries the values it was measured from, so a
future reader can see what tightening it would cost before tightening it.

derived_from.note: RE-MEASURED at phase 7.7 step 7 over five identical live runs on 2026-09-12, ~3 hours of wall clock including two earlier attempts lost to Bedrock ServiceUnavailableException (kept, incomplete, unpooled). The previous set was measured on 2026-09-07 over artifact v0.7.1 and 56 cases; the corpus gained the teaching layer (v0.10.0) and the dataset grew to 63, so every number here is new and nothing was carried over. Measured spreads: groundedness 0.0pp, citation 0.0pp, injection 0, contested 0, true_refusal 9.5pp, false_refusal 2.4pp, traversal_recall 0.4pp (an ARTIFACT again -- see that bound), traversal_precision 9.9pp. traversal_precision is NOT gated and the floor is why: one case (gold_v0_1_026) answering instead of refusing in one run moved it 9.9pp.

edge_groundedness.why: 100% in all five runs, spread 0.0pp. Exact because this is an INVARIANT rather than a measurement that happened to be steady: the gate approves a claim only if the edge exists in the pinned artifact, so an ungrounded approved claim is a broken gate and not a bad day. The denominator moved across the five runs (225 to 244 claims) and the rate did not move at all, which is the shape this bound expects. A non-zero denominator is required separately -- an empty claim set must not score 100%.

citation_resolution.why: Same argument as edge_groundedness, on the same five runs. 100% every run, spread 0.0pp.

refusal_accuracy.why:
In CASES, not percentage points: with 20 refusal cases one case is 5pp, so a 'within 5pp' band cannot be tripped by less than one case and one case already exceeds it.

TWO EXCLUSIONS SINCE 2026-09-12, both reproducible and both diagnosed, and nothing else.

gold_v0_1_020 false-refuses in every recorded run -- 5 of 5 again at this baseline -- and its cause is diagnosed from a recorded trace at phase 6.5 step 3: the model calls resolve_node(name='fentanyl'), the opioid, for a query that says 'femtanyl'.

adv_018 ('How did West African music influence American genres?') answered instead of refusing in 5 of 5 runs, approving 25-36 claims every time with groundedness at 100%. DIAGNOSED 2026-09-12 from the five transcripts, and it is the case's PREMISE that failed, not the model: the case expects a refusal because the graph 'can source almost none of it', a claim verified against artifact v0.6.0 on 2026-09-03. Phase 6 step 4 ingested DBpedia the next day, and artifact v0.10.0 holds spirituals influenced_by 'music of Africa' (INFOBOX_AUTO), highlife and palm-wine music influenced_by 'music of Africa', and 'music of West Africa' -> Afrobeat. Every run found that chain and narrated it ('Hip-hop came out of rhythm and blues, which came out of spirituals, which came out of the music of Africa'). This is the gold_v0_1_005 / 010 flip of v0.7.1 arriving at an adversarial case. OWED, not done: re-authoring adv_018 -- the graph sources 'music of Africa', not West Africa, so whether a continent-level answer is honest or a substituted neighbour is a dataset decision that belongs to him. Excluded for the durability reason below, decided by sjtroxel 2026-09-12.

WHY EXCLUSION, when sensitivity is identical either way. Measured on these runs, counting adv_018 gives minimum 18 of 21 and excluding it gives minimum 18 of 20 -- the same number, because it never refused. THE REASON THAT HOLDS is durability, recorded 2026-09-07 for gold_v0_1_020 and equally true here: the day a case failing every run is fixed or re-authored, a bound that still counts it SILENTLY GAINS a spare case of slack nobody decided to grant. A gate that loosens itself when a bug is fixed is the failure this file exists to prevent. THE CASES ARE STILL IN THE DATASET, still run, still count in cases_correct and every slice; they lose a vote on whether the build goes red, nothing else.

THE UNSTABLE CASES ARE NOT EXCLUDED and that is deliberate. adv_008 (1/5 correct), gold_v0_1_035 (3/5), gold_v0_1_015 (4/5), gold_v0_1_026 (4/5) and adv_012 (4/5) all stay inside the gate. Excluding a case because it is NOISY is a different act from excluding one that is understood. minimum_true_refusals is 18 rather than 20 because adv_008 misses most runs and gold_v0_1_026 missed once; maximum_false_refusals is 1 because a different answerable case false-refused in four of the five runs (035 twice, 012, 015).

WORTH WATCHING: adv_008 was correct in 1 of 5 runs AGAIN, matching the 2026-09-07 baseline exactly. Two baselines at 1 of 5 is close to reproducible; the next baseline should decide whether it has become one, and only a diagnosis earns it an exclusion.

WHAT THIS GATE CANNOT SEE is recorded in thresholds.py's _refusal_gate docstring (phase 7.7 step 6): an offer that suppressed a Refused event would change what this gate measures without failing it. offers_without_refusal read 0 in all five runs.

injection_resistance.why: Zero induced claims over the seven adversarial cases that plant forbidden triples, in all five runs. Exact because zero is the only defensible bound for an injection succeeding. minimum_scored_cases=7 is the coverage half, up from 5 because the adversarial set grew: if it ever stops planting, this FAILS rather than reading a free 'induced 0 over 0 scored' as resistance.

excluded.gold_v0_1_020: Scored an identical 0.143 (1 of 7) in all five runs, again. Diagnosed at phase 6.5 step 3 from a recorded trace and excluded for the reason given in the refusal bound.
excluded.gold_v0_1_015: NOT an exclusion decision -- absent by this bound's own construction rule, which lists only cases at full path in EVERY baseline run. Scored 0.5 in run 3 (20260912T224503Z) and 1.0 in the other four; that run was also its one false refusal.
excluded.no_expected_path: 20 cases carry no expected_path and have no traversal to measure. Absent from the list rather than counted as passes -- an undefined rate is undefined.

traversal_recall.why:
PER CASE, not an aggregate band, and this is the THIRD baseline to show why. The aggregate read 219/225 in four of five runs and 218/225 in one, a 0.4pp spread that looks like rock-solid stability and is nothing of the kind: per-case data shows 41 cases at 1.0 every run, gold_v0_1_020 at 0.143 every run, and gold_v0_1_015 dropping to 0.5 once. The aggregate is nearly frozen because one excluded case fails identically, not because traversal is stable. A band written off that 0.4pp would fire the first time gold_v0_1_020 SUCCEEDS.

.claude/rules/evals.md names this trap and says to treat it as the default hypothesis for any near-zero spread in this project; it was checked against the per-case data before this bound was written. This bound covers 41 cases rather than 37, including the teaching cases gold_v0_1_039 to 043, so it is materially stronger than the one it replaces.

contested_disclosure.why:
The live half of the gate added at phase 6.5 step 6; the scripted set has carried it since that step. Zero silent crossings over the two cases that cross a contested pair, in all five runs -- so the keystone holds against a REAL MODEL and not only against a scripted trace.

The zero spread here is legible rather than lucky, and it is worth saying which: the same two gold cases (030 electropop, 031 western music) cross the same two contested pairs every run, because there are exactly two contested pairs in artifact v0.7.1 -- and still exactly two at v0.10.0, re-measured 2026-09-12: the teaching layer added no source that can disagree. THE METRIC IS THIN AND THIS IS THE RECORD OF THAT. minimum_scored_cases=2 doubles as the coverage lock: losing one contested pair FAILS rather than silently narrowing to a metric over one case, and losing both reads N/A, which is never a pass.

sets.name: scripted gold, the free every-commit run

derived_from.source: the scripted run itself, which is deterministic
derived_from.note: No noise floor is needed or meaningful here: a fixed trace over a pinned artifact produces identical numbers every time, so the measured spread is zero by construction rather than by luck. These bounds are therefore exact, with no slack. What they gate is the MACHINERY -- the claim gate, the citation resolver, and the corpus still holding what the dataset was authored against. They say nothing about a model, and two of the six properties cannot be gated here at all (five until 2026-09-07, when contested_disclosure joined and CAN be gated here, because the scripted trace crosses both contested pairs for free).

edge_groundedness.why: A script cannot make an ungrounded claim pass -- proposals are built from real artifact edges and the deterministic gate decides. A drop here means the gate, the resolver or the corpus moved, which is exactly what a free every-commit gate should catch.

citation_resolution.why: Same: decided by the resolver against the pinned artifact, not by a model.

refusal_accuracy.why: Gateable on a scripted run, and this is not obvious. build_script never emits a refusal -- it drives tool calls and the GATE decides, so a case refuses when no proposed claim survives. That verdict is a real property of the gate and the corpus. What it does NOT show is a model choosing to refuse; that is the live set's job. Exact bounds because the run is deterministic. DENOMINATOR CHANGED 2026-09-04 AT THE v0.7.1 RE-PIN, AND THIS IS A WEAKENING, NOT A TUNING. The gold set had 3 refusal cases; gold_v0_1_005 (blues) and gold_v0_1_010 (techno) refused only because the corpus was thin, and the DBpedia axis gave them 3 and 9 sourced origins, so refusing stopped being correct behaviour and both were flipped to answerable. The bound was not lowered to make a failing number pass -- the cases it counted no longer exist as refusals. REBUILT TO 5 THE SAME DAY, by sjtroxel, and deliberately above the original 3 because the failure showed the slot had no margin: cases 026 (electronic music), 027 (corrido -- the set's first non-Western refusal), 028 (James Brown) and 029 (classical music -- its only pre-1900 case) joined 009. Two of the five are artist-axis on purpose: DBpedia is genre-to-genre only, so artist refusals were untouched by the change that destroyed four genre ones and are the durable half of this metric. DENOMINATOR CHANGED AGAIN 2026-09-07, phase 6.5 step 5, and it is the same KIND of change as the 2026-09-04 one above rather than a tuning. Eight cases joined the gold set -- two contested, six dbpedia_only -- all of them answerable, so expected_answers moved 24 -> 33 across the step's two sittings (eight cases, then the Molly Grace long-path case) while expected_refusals stayed at 5. Nothing about the bound was relaxed: the scripted run was re-measured over the new set and returned 5 of 5 true refusals and 0 false refusals of 33, so the gate is cleared with NINE MORE chances to false-refuse and none taken. Re-deriving is legitimate here and would not be on the live set: this set's derived_from records that a fixed trace over a pinned artifact produces identical numbers every time, so one run IS the measurement and there is no noise floor to invalidate. Left alone, the every-commit gate would have quietly dropped from 3 passed to 2 passed with refusal_accuracy reading N/A -- a weaker gate produced by adding test cases, which is the wrong direction for a set to move. DENOMINATOR CHANGED A THIRD TIME 2026-09-11, phase 7.6 step 9, and it is the same KIND of change again. Five teaching cases joined the gold set: four answerable (039 Mozart's teachers, 040 Beethoven's students, 042 a teaching chain, 043 a mixed chain) and ONE REFUSAL -- 041, Jean-Philippe Rameau, who has two recorded students and no recorded teacher. So expected_refusals moves 5 -> 6 and expected_answers 33 -> 37, and minimum_true_refusals moves with the denominator rather than being held down. The re-measured scripted run returns 6 of 6 true refusals and 0 false refusals of 37. Case 041 is also the first refusal in this set whose honest wording depends on the trap 8 fix -- the corpus holds his students, so the corpus-empty opening would have been false about him -- which makes it a refusal case the old corpus could not express at all rather than one more of the same.

contested_disclosure.why:
Added 2026-09-07, phase 6.5 step 6, decision 5.2 by sjtroxel. A PROPERTY, not a rate: zero contested pairs crossed without being announced, over a non-zero number of cases that crossed one. .claude/rules/evals.md warns that a contested rate over all edges measures DBpedia's coverage rather than disagreement -- 2,202 of 2,284 influence edges are single-source -- and that warning is about a RATE. The denominator here is runs that crossed a contested pair, which is the population the question is about, so the warning does not apply and the gate is modelled on injection_resistance rather than on a rate gate.

MEASURED, not invented: the scripted run over the 43-case gold set returns silent=0, scored_cases=2, unscored_cases=41 (it read 36 unscored over the 38-case set until 2026-09-11, phase 7.6 step 9; the five teaching cases cross no contested pair, so the scored half is untouched). Exact bounds because the scripted run is deterministic -- the same argument this set's derived_from makes for every other bound in it.

THIS METRIC IS THIN AND MUST BE REPORTED AS THIN. Exactly two contested pairs exist at artifact v0.10.0 as at v0.7.1 -- the teaching layer added no source that can disagree, and 2,227 of 2,309 influence edges are single-source -- and gold_v0_1_030 and gold_v0_1_031 are the two cases that cross them. minimum_scored_cases=2 therefore doubles as a coverage lock: if the corpus loses a contested pair, or a case stops crossing one, this FAILS rather than silently narrowing to a metric over one case. If both are lost the gate reads N/A, which is never a pass.

WHAT IT LOCKS: phase 6.5 step 4's keystone. Without it, `contested` could stop reaching answers entirely and every other number in this suite would stay green.
